title: Graph a proportional relationship and interpret the unit rate as the slope

questions.skill: Graph a proportional relationship and interpret the unit rate as the slope
questions.response: draw on the figure and write an answer
questions.prompt: A car uses gas at a constant rate: 3 gallons for every 90 miles. Graph the relationship between gallons (x) and miles (y). What is the slope, and what does it mean?
questions.prompt_markup:
A car uses gas at a constant rate: 3 gallons for every 90 miles.
Graph the relationship between gallons (x) and miles (y). What is the slope, and what does it mean?
questions.correct_answer: 30; the car travels 30 miles per gallon.
questions.drawing_answer: A straight line through (0, 0) and points such as (1, 30) and (3, 90)
questions.grading_note: Grade both: the line through the origin with slope 30, and the slope with its meaning.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 6 and y from 0 to 180. x-axis label "Gallons", y-axis label "Miles". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.

sections.skill: Compare properties of functions represented in different ways

questions.skill: Compare properties of functions represented in different ways
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 10 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: f(x) = 2.5x. The table shows g(x) = x². Which function has the greater average rate of change from x = 0 to x = 4? Give both rates.
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = 2.5x. The table shows g(x) = x².
Which function has the greater average rate of change from x = 0 to x = 4? Give both rates.
questions.correct_answer: g: its average rate is 16 ÷ 4 = 4, and f's is 2.5.
questions.grading_note: Both rates and the comparison are required.

questions.skill: Compare properties of functions represented in different ways
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 10 as a second forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.prompt: f(x) = 40 + 5x and g(x) = 30(1.2)^x. Which function has the greater initial value? Which is greater at x = 10? Round values to the nearest tenth.
questions.prompt_markup:
f(x) = 40 + 5x and g(x) = 30(1.2)^x.
Which function has the greater initial value? Which is greater at x = 10? Round values to the nearest tenth.
questions.correct_answer: f has the greater initial value (40 > 30); g is greater at x = 10 (about 185.8, while f(10) = 90).
